Tess (Marketing): Heads-up: planning a small launch note for the new 'cost-saver' config guide — aiming publish next Thu 9:00 AM PT. Need legal signoff + one exec quote by Wed noon. Draft in /marketing/drafts/cost-saver.md

Omar (PR): Proposed embargo 8:30 AM PT, one-pager + hi-res chart. I can prep a short reporter list (TechCrunch + trade). Do we want a partner teaser?

Lena (Legal): Will review. Please avoid absolute claims like 'guaranteed savings'. Use precise % numbers from our benchmark table. Add benchmarking footnote.

Ravi (Product): Chart uploaded to /marketing/assets/cost-saver-chart.png. Footnote: "Benchmarks on our internal harness; results vary by workload."

PublishBot: Publish job scheduled: channel=marketing/blog, publish_at=2026-06-10T16:00:00Z, embargo_until=2026-06-10T15:30:00Z, job_id=115900.

Tess (Marketing): Checklist: legal (Lena), exec quote (Ravi), chart (Ravi), press kit (Omar), analytics (Infra). Please react :thumbsup: when ready.

Lena (Legal): :thumbsup: wording approved, removed 'guaranteed' language.

Omar (PR): :thumbsup: I'll hold outreach until publish.

Ravi (Product): :thumbsup: exec quote secured from CTO.

Tess (Marketing): Great  thanks all — will monitor publish day.
